newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Viscoplast sets IPO price at PLN 14.
newsitem.headline: Polish Viscoplast sets IPO price at PLN 14.

text.p: Polish chemical company Viscoplast SA set the issue price of its initial public offering of 900,000 shares at 14 zlotys per share, the firm said in a statement on Tuesday.
Previously Viscoplast, which plans to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, had said a final issue price between 12 and 16 zlotys would be set through bookbuilding.
Large investors will be able to register for up to 65,000 shares each in the firm's 690,000-share large-investor tranche from January 27 to February 5.
Small investors will register for a total of 210,000 shares from January 27 to January 31.
The issue has been underwritten by bank BIG and National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 11 in Poland's mass privatisation programme.
Viscoplast netted 3.6 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 36 million zlotys.
It expects to net 1.8 million zlotys in 1996 and 2.8 million zlotys in 1997.
